name: TESSA EU AI Act Benchmark Dataset
description: This dataset contains the supplementary evaluation material for TESSA, a governance-oriented educational artifact providing guidance on the EU AI Act. It includes 100 benchmark questions across ten thematic evaluation categories, expected outcomes, responses generated by TESSA and baseline ChatGPT, preliminary LLM-assisted assessments, and final lawyer-validated assessments. The dataset supports transparency and reproducibility of the evaluation reported in the associated TESSA research paper.
